latest.title: Cholesky-Vinberg and Log-Vinberg means on the Vinberg cone
latest.abstract: We study two means on the five-dimensional Vinberg cone $Ω$, viewed as a sparse cone of positive definite $3\times3$ matrices. The Cholesky-Vinberg mean is obtained from the simply transitive solvable group $H$ associated with $Ω$. It is $H$-equivariant, and its interpolation curves are geodesics for two flat metric connections with torsion. One of the corresponding metrics is the canonical Hessian metric of the cone. The Log-Vinberg mean is defined by affine interpolation in the global logarithmic coordinates of the associated Vinberg algebra, or clan. The resulting Riemannian metric is complete and flat, and its weighted Fréchet means have explicit formulas. Both constructions preserve the zero pattern defining $Ω$.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在五维 Vinberg 锥构造保稀疏零模式的两类矩阵均值及显式 Fréchet 均值。
latest.breakthrough: 给出适合指定稀疏锥的闭式均值几何。
latest.limitations: 局限特定五维锥，不能直接推广到任意稀疏正定矩阵。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
